From 1 to 30 March 2024, Owen was a Visiting Fellow in the [Theoretical Sciences Visiting Program (TSVP)](https://www.oist.jp/visiting-program){target="_blank"} at the [Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST)](https://www.oist.jp/){target="_blank"}, Japan.

TSVP brings researchers from across disciplines to OIST for extended visits, intensifying collaborations within OIST's interdisciplinary research environment — a chance to work alongside theoreticians outside ecology and bring some of that thinking back to the group's own predictive work.
